**Use your skills to revolutionize HR with Team Spirit and Innovation at NTT DATA

**Are you ready to be a part of a team that is reshaping the world of HR, making a real impact for our clients? As our new Employee Central consultant, you will get to combine leadership, technical expertise and business understanding with your genuine mentor mentality.

**A Close-Knit team – and a One-Stop-Shop for Pioneering HR Solutions

**We would like to invite you into a collaborative and inclusive environment where each member is a vital part of our success. Our culture is laid-back yet professional, with room for a good laugh and a shared commitment to excellence. This can be felt all the way to our clients, who often talk about the enjoyable and effective partnerships they have with us.

“We’re proud of being a comprehensive solution for all things HR – from SuccessFactors and support to strategic HR advisory. And as part of the larger NTT DATA Business Solutions network, we can leverage cutting-edge AI technology, ensuring our clients receive the most advanced and efficient solutions available,” says Danny Haschke, SuccessFactors Consultant.

**Innovative Employee Central Implementation with ready2run®

**As a Senior Employee Central Consultant, you will lead large, international and complex implementations, taking ownership of the Employee Central workstream from design through deployment. ready2run® builds on our preconfigured starting solution, proven delivery framework and the way we shape implementation projects and customer offerings.

**Specifically, You Will

**

• Translate business needs into robust, scalable solutions.

• Help customers benefit from our ready2run® approach – both as a methodology and a mindset.

• Play an important part in strengthening our collective capability by sharing knowledge, supporting collaboration across projects and helping junior consultants grow their confidence and expertise.

**Combine your strong technical expertise with your business understanding

**In this role, you will need a proactive focus on quality, detail and delivery, using your critical thinking skills and experience in resolving complex technical and functional issues in a timely and effective manner. Also, you possess a genuine desire to guide, challenge and develop colleagues, review work and share practical knowledge – and you can do so constructively in international teams. Moreover, with your strong communication skills, you engage effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders and build trusted relationships with colleagues and clients alike.

Finally, we know nobody is perfect, but we imagine that you may:

• Have several years of hands-on experience configuring and implementing SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central.

• Have proven experience leading large, international and complex implementations, with ownership of the Employee Central workstream from design to deployment.

• Possess strong Employee Central solution knowledge, combined with the ability to analyze HR processes and translate business priorities into practical, scalable design.

• Be open to travelling and working on diverse projects, adapting to new challenges and environments.

• Be fluent in English (this is required), with additional Scandinavian languages being a plus.

• The role can be based in any Nordic country, with the expectation that you are within practical daily commuting distance of one of our local offices.

**Will you give us the opportunity to let you shine?

**Applicants are assessed continuously, so do not wait! Apply now and take the first step towards a fulfilling career with us at NTT DATA Business Solutions. We are excited to welcome you and see what we can achieve together.

**Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

**At NTT DATA Business Solutions, we believe our strength lies in our diversity. We proudly embrace people from all walks of life, regardless of ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, religion, or background. Our diverse perspectives fuel innovation and create a richer, more creative work environment for everyone.

_At NTT DATA Business Solutions, we drive innovation – from advisory and implementation to managed services and beyond, powered by a global team of over 19,000 experts representing over 90 nations in more than 30 countries. With SAP at our core and a powerful ecosystem of partners like Microsoft and ServiceNow, we continuously improve solutions and AI-driven technology to make them work for companies – and for their people.

_We are part of NTT DATA, a $30+ _billion business and technology services, AI and digital infrastructure leader. As a Global Top Employer, NTT DATA serves 75% of the Fortune Global 100 and, with experts in over 70 countries, co-innovates solutions that encourage experimentation and recognize great work.

__With us, you have endless opportunities to think big, act bold and take ownership. Make this the place where you belong, learn, and build your network.

_NTT DATA Business Solutions: Make this the place where Y__ou grow.

jobs.occupation: Senior Financial Controller, Group Accounting & Controlling
jobs.description:
Do you want to join a global leader in renewable energy infrastructure? If so, CIP Fund Solutions is looking for a Senior Financial Controller to join our office in Copenhagen.

Team

You will be a part of a team consisting of five skilled financial professionals and will support our financial strategy to align with CIP FS’ ambitious long-term goals.

You will engage senior stakeholders to provide crucial financial insights across our platform companies and regions.

Role

Reporting to the VP of Global Controlling and Financial Reporting, you will contribute to the consolidation of the group’s financial statements and related reporting processes. You will be responsible for ensuring high-quality financial reporting and compliance with relevant accounting standards, and for supporting the business with accurate and timely insights.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Analyzing consolidated accounting and management performance reports

• Driving improvements in reporting processes and financial controls

• Collaborating with finance teams across the organization to ensure best practices in group reporting

• Close cooperation with the global capability center (shared service center)

• Participating in monthly liquidity calls and collection of receivables.

• Oversight and controlling of service provider activities and point of contact for local service providers responsible for finance and corporate matters

• Acting as a contact for auditors and internal stakeholders

You

You have an MSc in Economics or Finance and 3-5 years of full-time experience in audit, financial controlling, or consultancy from a Big4 firm. You also have experience in consolidation and are motivated by building best practices, solving complex issues and developing the finance function.

We look for the following in a candidate:

• Comprehensive knowledge of cost accounting and controlling

• Advanced analytical skills and attention to detail

• Effective time management, with the ability to prioritize assignments and manage short deadlines

• Solid communication skills and ability to collaborate across functions

• Curious and self-driven

• Danish GAAP and consolidation principles knowledge

• Fluency in English, both spoken and written

• Experience with Business Central and OneStream is an advantage

The process

Please apply online as soon as possible as applications will be processed on an ongoing basis. For questions related to the role, please reach out to our Talent Acquisition team at recruitment@cipfs.com. We do not include CV's and Cover Letters sent by email.

As we continue to improve our candidate experience, diversity and avoid unconscious bias, please avoid having a photo in your CV. We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality for all applicants.

Please be aware that we will not accept speculative CV submissions for any of our roles from recruitment agencies, and any unsolicited candidate submissions will be exempt from any payment expectations and ownership.

CIP Fund Solutions’ commitment to diversity and inclusion

CIP Fund Solutions is committed to securing a diverse and inclusive work environment where everyone feels respected and heard.

A diverse workforce allows CIP Fund Solutions to achieve results through different approaches and solutions to task execution and problem solving. We want all our employees to have equal opportunities for personal growth and career opportunities regardless of age, gender, sexual orientation, disability, religion, nationality, or ethnicity.

CIP Fund Solutions

CIP FS’ purpose is to enable CIP’s ambition to scale rapidly over the coming strategy-period - supporting our colleagues with professional and efficient financial, legal, tax and business operations through the cycle from fund formation and capital raising, to deploying investments into construction of large-scale greenfield renewable energy assets, as well as M&A.

For more information, please visit CIP Fund Solutions.

We are looking for a new team member to step into the role of Key Account Manager, driving Consumer Electronics partnerships with passion and pride for our company, EET Retail, based in Birkerød, North Zealand. The majority of your customers will be based in Denmark, so strong knowledge of the Danish market is your most important qualification, though familiarity with the broader Nordic region remains valuable.

Location:

Northern Zealand and Copenhagen area.

Who are you?

You have an energetic personality with experience from CE sales within retail in Scandinavia. You can build new, relevant contacts and turn them into long-lasting partnerships.

Your most important qualification is your drive to succeed with your partners, a tireless desire to sell concepts instead of products. You are self-motivated and structured in how you work, and a true team player.

Personal characteristics:

•    You are committed and professionally sharp. You take responsibility and can work both independently and in a team.

•    You take pride in developing solutions tailored to our resellers' needs and are driven by creating value for both the company and our partners.

•    You are enthusiastic about creating new business in partnership with our resellers and vendors.

•    You have business understanding and can adapt to changing focus and tasks.

•    You thrive at a fast pace and are motivated by challenging tasks and clear success criteria.

•    You are highly self-initiating and keen to learn the latest trends and technologies.

•    You are willing to travel and meet customers throughout the Nordic region.

•    You are results-driven, confident, and a strong communicator.

Our expectations:

•    You have solid experience from a manufacturer or distributor within Consumer Electronics, with strong product knowledge and a commercial drive to generate sales.

•    You have a background as Business Manager, Key Account Manager, Category Manager, or similar, with a minimum of 6–8 years of sales experience in similar roles.

•    You have an in-depth understanding of the Danish retail structure in particular, as this is where the majority of your customers will be based. Familiarity with the broader Nordic landscape is a plus.

•    You have an exceptional understanding of the entire value chain, including business processes, and think opportunistically in your approach.

•    You have insight into concept and assortment development and have worked on developing product categories.

•    You are solution and result-oriented, emphasizing results together with resellers, independently and in partnership, while maintaining a high level of integrity as a trustworthy business partner.

•    You are experienced in negotiations at both a strategic and tactical level, including annual negotiations, and comfortable balancing long-term strategy with short-term sales-out focus.

•    You are familiar with MS Office, with strong Excel skills and a high level of proficiency in Word and PowerPoint.

•    You are fluent, verbally and in writing, in Danish and English, and preferably also comfortable communicating in Swedish and/or Norwegian.

•    A driving license is mandatory.

The job:

You will introduce Consumer Electronics brands, develop retail concepts, and sell Consumer Electronics and Telecom accessories from leading vendors to Danish and broader Nordic retailers. You have an in-depth understanding of assortment composition and are able to identify opportunities based on resellers' needs.

Your primary tasks:

•    Manage and develop relationships with retail customers, including major Danish retail chains and telecom operators.

•    Identify, develop, and drive sales of our product portfolio within Consumer Electronics, Smart Home, and Telecom accessories.

•    Develop and implement channel strategies and customer plans, and conduct annual negotiations.

•    Drive campaign planning and follow-up in relation to execution, results, frequency, and product mix.

•    Analyse and process sales figures and other relevant data to continuously optimize initiatives and secure a leading market position.

•    Maintain daily contact with resellers to follow up on sales, assortment, and performance.

•    Work proactively with market data, including analysis of customer sales data, to take commercial action with our partners.

•    Develop campaign plans in dialogue with resellers, ensuring alignment with stakeholders such as colleagues in Product Management and Trade Marketing.

•    Ensure timely deliveries via forecasting, in close dialogue with the buyer.

•    Share knowledge and spar actively with your team.

•    Provide management reporting at customer level.

We offer:

•    An exciting job with great responsibility.

•    The opportunity to sell innovative, high-quality products in a dynamic market.

•    A place in an energetic, high-performance sales team within a stable company with strong drive.

•    An active staff association with many activities.

•    Pension scheme and health insurance.

A results-oriented organization with strong career prospects

You will be part of a results-oriented organization in exciting development, executing an aggressive growth strategy through both organic growth and acquisitions.

Please send your application and CV in English, with relevant attachments HERE. Applications are processed on an ongoing, confidential basis — feel free to send yours today.

If you'd like to know more about the role, you're welcome to contact Managing Director, Allan Friis: +45 45 82 19 19.

About EET Retail

EET Retail is an entity under EET Group, focused on Consumer Electronics products and the Retail segment.

EET Retail is the result of many years of strong growth within Retail and Consumer Electronics in EET Group across the Nordics. Now we have joined our forces and extensive industry knowledge in one Retail focused company, tailored to meet the needs of our partners.

We are a strong team with more than 20 experienced and passionate Retail profiles. We pride ourselves in our focus on building strong partnerships with both resellers and vendors to grow our combined long-term businesses.

We strive to be the go-to Retail Partner for both resellers and vendors when entering a market, and we represent a strong portfolio with market leading brands such as: JBL, Sonos, Netatmo, Targus, tado°, Sharp, Nanoleaf, Panasonic, Vogel’s, Hyper, JLab, Aqara, Epson, Harman Kardon, iFixit, Danfoss, eSTUFF, Adata, Sandberg, beyerdynamic, SumUp, Samsonite and many more.

More information here.

About EET Group

EET Group is a value-adding specialist IT distributor, providing suppliers and customers with expert industry knowledge, intelligent logistics solutions, unique sales service and smart marketing tools. We operate in 23 markets across Europe, carry over 1.100 brands and serve more than 30.000 buying customers annually.

More information here.

Do you want to help shape the future of data and analytics in a global MedTech company?

Ambu is on an exciting digital transformation journey, investing heavily in our Enterprise Data Platform to strengthen data-driven decision-making across the business. We are looking for a Data Engineer to join our Data & Analytics team at our headquarters in Denmark and play a key role in designing, building, and maintaining enterprise-scale data solutions.

Working with modern Microsoft technologies and cloud-based solutions on Azure, you will collaborate with business stakeholders, solution architects, system managers, and fellow data professionals to deliver impactful solutions that support critical business processes across our global organization.

This is a unique opportunity to combine your software engineering background with data engineering expertise while contributing to innovative healthcare solutions that improve patient care worldwide.

**The role

**As a Data Engineer, You Will Be Involved In The Design, Development And Support Of Solutions Across Ambu's Data Landscape, Including

• Enterprise Data Warehouse solutions

• Master Data Management (MDM) solutions

• Data integrations and APIs

• Cloud-based Azure data services

• Bespoke data solutions supporting various business functions

**Your Key Responsibilities Will Include

**

• Designing, developing and maintaining enterprise data solutions

• Building and supporting data integration pipelines and interfaces

• Collaborating with business stakeholders to understand and translate requirements into technical solutions

• Ensuring data quality, reliability and performance across the data platform

• Participating in project delivery, testing and solution deployment activities

• Supporting and enhancing existing data solutions

• Contributing to data governance, architecture and best practices

• Identifying opportunities to improve and modernize the data platform

**Suggested candidate profile

**Setting you up for success is one of our cornerstones. We imagine you have a robust educational background in computer science, software engineering, data science, or a related field, combined with hands-on experience building and supporting data solutions in a modern cloud environment.

**More Specifically, You Bring

**

• A background in Software Engineering and experience applying software development principles and best practices

• Strong SQL and data modelling skills

• Experience with Microsoft Azure data technologies and cloud services

• Experience developing ETL/ELT solutions, data pipelines, and integrations

• Knowledge of APIs and data integration patterns

• Understanding of Data Warehousing, Master Data Management (MDM), Data Quality, and Data Governance principles

• Experience with Python, C# or similar programming languages

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

**Please note that due to the upcoming summer holiday period, the recruitment process may take slightly longer than usual. We expect to begin the interview process in August.

****Ambu – a visionary and international workplace where your efforts matter

**Ambu is a company that expands rapidly and has ambitious growth targets. We meet these targets through interdisciplinary teamwork between motivated and highly skilled employees. Your contributions and efforts are crucial to our success and by joining us you will get the opportunity to work in an international head office with an informal working environment.

We offer great opportunities for personal development. Furthermore, we offer a wide range of professional, social and financial employee benefits in addition to exciting job challenges and continuous professional and personal development.

jobs.occupation: Electrical & Instrumentation Engineer at Novo Nordisk Engineering
jobs.description:
If you're energised by shaping the future of instrumentation and automation technologies and thrive in a pharmaceutical engineering environment, we'd love to hear from you!

**Who We Are

**We are a leading pharma engineering company shaping the future of API pharma engineering globally. Leveraging the expertise of 2,000+ employees across Denmark, India, and the US, we design, build and optimise pharmaceutical manufacturing facilities that are essential to the health and well-being of patients everywhere.

Our success is driven by passion, innovation, and collaboration — with our customers and across our teams and disciplines. If you share our dedication to a noble cause and our passion for API pharma engineering, then NNE is the place for you.

**About The Role

**We are looking for an Electrical & Instrumentation Engineer to join our Electrical & Instrumentation Department, consisting of approximately 100 engineers and specialists.

You will become part of a team of 100 engineers working across projects to design and deliver robust process control and instrumentation solutions for pharmaceutical facilities. Together, we cover everything from engineering design and specifications to testing, validation, and commissioning.

In this role, you will work closely with colleagues, vendors, and clients to ensure that electrical and instrumentation solutions meet both technical requirements and regulatory standards.

Please note that Danish language skills are required for this position.

Location Denmark - Kalundborg

Experience + 3 years

Department Electrical & Instrumentation

**How You Might Spend Your Days

**As an E&I Engineer you’ll be:

• Design and develop instrumented designs for our current & up-coming projects

• Working with vendor and client representatives in carrying out the validation activities

• Design, development, acquisition and implementation of various sensors, actuators and control solutions to meet i.e. Functional Safety, SIS and ATEX requirements

• Commissioning, testing, qualification and validation of electrical instruments solutions

• Supervising and construction coordination

• Participating in project teams, contributing to technical problem-solving and continuous improvement

**Who You Are

**We care about who you are as a person. In the end, how you work, and your energy is what impacts the results we achieve as a team. As a person, you are:

• Curious and eager to learn new skills

• Comfortable in developing close relations with stakeholders

• Taking responsibility for your tasks and approaching them proactively

• Motivated to keep deadlines and quality requirements

• Supportive and contribute to the good collaboration atmosphere

• Fostering cross organisational learning and knowledge sharing

**What You Bring To The Role

**In all positions, there are some things that are preferred, and others, a bonus. If you do not meet all the qualifications listed below, you are welcome to offer alternative experience that you think would be valuable in this role:

• Degree in Electrical Engineering, Marine Engineering, Automation or a similar field

• + 3 years of experience within electrical, instrumentation or automation engineering

• + 2 years of hands-on experience with onsite work

• Understanding of process control systems and industrial instrumentation

• Experienced in working with industrial standards and requirements, sensors and instrumentation and PI&D’s

• Commissioning, testing or validation of technical systems

• Professional level in both English and Danish

**Why choose NNE?

**NNE is short for Novo Nordisk Engineering. And for all of us who work here, NNE means so much more.

At NNE, you become part of a vibrant, project-based environment built on close day-to-day collaboration. The role is therefore primarily on-site, with physical presence at the workplace expected five days a week. Limited flexibility for occasional remote work may be accommodated in line with business needs.

We are, at our core, a people business and, as such, committed to continuously developing our people and the way we work together. We do not expect you to know it all from day one, and we truly believe a great start makes a real difference. We therefore welcome new colleagues with our award-nominated onboarding programme, supported by a range of in-house talent and development initiatives designed to support your long-term growth.

You can read more about the benefits we offer **here .

****Did we spark your curiosity? If you’re ready to join our passion, let’s hear from you.

****Deadline of application is 15th December 2026

**Questions before applying? Send us a quick text to arrange a convenient time to chat. Contact Manager Søren Hedegaard on +45 3079 8206

**Please note:

**

• We only accept applications submitted through our online recruitment system

• You do not need to attach a cover letter, but please include a few sentences about why you are applying in your resume or CV

• We invite to interviews on a running basis.

**Fair hiring:

**At NNE, we are committed to an inclusive recruitment process and equal opportunities for all job applicants. To maintain fairness, we request that you refrain from including a personal photo in your CV.

We’re looking for a Director of Revenue Operations (RevOps) to own the commercial operating system across the group's portfolio brands of Cookie Information, Piwik PRO and Sheltr. You will lead the commercial operating plan, the shared CRM and data, attribution, forecasting, and the objective arbitration of capacity across commercial teams. This role reports to the CCO.

The Director of RevOps is the key connective role between leadership and the commercial team leads, translating strategy into an operating plan they run with, and turning their execution data into insight leadership can act on to drive predictable, efficient and sustainable revenue growth.

We are open to on-site, hybrid, and remote working within two time zones of our offices (CET).

In this role, please expect to travel up to 40% of the time.

**About Us

**Our group brings together three European software brands that help organisations earn and use data with trust: Cookie Information for consent management; Piwik PRO for privacy-by-design analytics and data activation; and Sheltr for reliably finding personal data in internal data sources.

Headquartered in Copenhagen with an office in Wrocław, our team of 180 people have been building trusted data solutions since 2011. We work with companies and marketing teams across various industries that take control of their data model, including some of the most data-sensitive clients in healthcare, finance, energy & utilities, and the public sector. We are proud that our clients rely on us to meet GDPR and EU data residency requirements across EMEA and the US, as this regulatory depth is hard to build and replicate. We believe compliance and performance are not opposites. Consented data, auditable analytics and full visibility of personal data belong to one data journey; together they form a foundation that marketing, IT, legal and the C-level can rely on.

Our journey is to move from a regulation-driven house of brands to one unified company with a clear point of view. We are creating a new category around this complete data journey, and together we are building an enterprise-ready, data-driven revenue engine led by thought leadership. Want to join us on this journey? Keep reading to find out how you can help shape this with us.

The Role

As Director of RevOps, you will own the commercial revenue engine across all three brands, ensuring alignment between strategy, processes, technology and performance. You will build and lead a multidisciplinary team and act as a strategic partner to commercial leadership, driving operational excellence and turning insights into business outcomes.

Your key responsibilities will include:

• Owning the commercial operating plan, revenue forecasting and pipeline performance across the portfolio, translating business objectives into clear priorities and measurable outcomes.

• Establish a shared CRM, account universe, campaign calendar and consistent funnel definitions, ensuring reliable data, clear processes and effective collaboration across brands.

• Driving data-led improvements in conversion, deal size, customer acquisition cost, customer lifetime value and return on investment. Lead reporting and performance reviews for the CCO, CEO and Finance.

• Providing an objective, data-driven perspective on commercial capacity and investment trade-offs, escalating key decisions to the CCO when needed.

• Owning the commercial technology stack, including HubSpot, BI, forecasting, marketing automation and AI, ensuring our tools and data enable scalable growth.

• Leading BI, marketing automation, customer and partner enablement, and product marketing. Partner with Product on feature prioritisation, pricing and packaging to strengthen go-to-market effectiveness.

**About You

**You are an experienced B2B SaaS RevOps leader who understands how to build a scalable, data-driven revenue engine. You combine strong commercial and financial acumen with analytical rigour and the ability to influence senior stakeholders across Sales, Marketing, Product and Finance.

You thrive in complex environments where you can bring structure, align competing priorities and turn data into better commercial decisions.

You bring:

• Significant experience leading Revenue Operations or owning the Sales and Marketing revenue engine in a B2B SaaS business.

• Strong commercial and financial understanding, including ARR, NRR, churn, CAC, customer lifetime value and payback.

• Deep expertise in pipeline management, funnel design, forecasting, attribution and performance optimisation.

• Advanced HubSpot expertise, including architecture, governance and process design.

• Experience with BI, marketing automation, AI and revenue technology.

• Experience leading multidisciplinary, hybrid-working teams and driving change across functions without relying solely on formal authority.

• Strong executive communication skills and the ability to influence C-level decision-making.

• Fluency in English (C2).

Nice-to-haves:

• Experience managing multi-brand or multi-product go-to-market operations on shared infrastructure.

• Experience with partner and channel models or account-based marketing.

• Familiarity with forecasting, conversation intelligence and advanced BI tools.

• Background in privacy, MarTech or analytics.

• Experience in a scale-up or PE- or VC-backed business.

• Fluency in German, French or a Nordic language.

What we offer

• Real ownership: Lead the commercial operating model across a three-brand portfolio.

• You’ll work closely with the CCO, CEO and commercial leadership to shape business priorities and decisions.

• You get to build shared systems, processes and insights that enable more effective and scalable commercial execution.

• A chance to make an impact: Strengthen how three growing SaaS brands plan, execute and scale their commercial growth through better data, processes and insights.

• Professional development budget, health insurance, and other benefits.

• A positive, informal workplace.

Application process

We’re looking to fill the position as soon as possible and will be inviting candidates for interviews on an ongoing basis, so don’t hesitate to send your application today.

This is what our recruitment process looks like:

• A brief screening call with our Talent Partner (online, approx. 30 mins)

• An in-depth interview with the hiring manager and a member of the team

• Interview with a key stakeholder including a live case

• A final interview with our CCO

This process is subject to change. All applicants who progress to the screening call will be informed of the full process as some stages may be combined and/or in person.

Our Commitment to Diversity & Inclusion

At Cookie Information & Piwik PRO we value diversity as a cornerstone of our success. We welcome applications from all backgrounds and do not discriminate based on race, religion, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability. We recognise that certain groups are underrepresented in the tech industry, and we encourage everyone to apply and help us shape a more inclusive workspace.

**The Impact You'll Make

**As our Program Manager, Incubation Data Center (m/f/d), you will play a key role in driving innovation within the Data Center Business Unit at Danfoss Power Solutions, preferably based in Copenhagen, Denmark. You'll lead local and global cross-functional project teams from initiation and planning through execution, monitoring, control and closure, ensuring successful delivery of the agreed business case. You'll take ownership of low- to medium-risk programs across new product development (NPD), product-related initiatives, large-scale new business onboarding and cost-out/value analysis and value engineering (VA/VE) projects.

Your impact will be measured by successful project delivery, transparent reporting to leadership and timely corrective action. You'll also help develop and continuously improve processes, guidelines and tools for new product development, bringing teams together and driving accountability in a matrix organization.

**What You’ll Be Doing

**

• Plan and lead medium-complexity programs: build program management plans, cross-functionally informed work breakdown structures (WBS) and schedules; align priorities, staffing, requirements and a robust Statement of Work (SoW) before baseline; ensure the team understands contractual commitments and baseline change control.

• Drive disciplined execution and delivery: manage scope and scope changes, run regular team meetings, follow through on commitments and action items, and assess program health through earned-value measures (CPI/SPI), quality, technical performance, Focus 5 and delivery indicators. Identify and quantify risks and opportunities, implement mitigation plans and initiate corrective actions when needed.

• Own the business case and customer outcomes: understand the strategic product roadmap and how the organization develops and launches products; validate customer needs and pain points with relevant stakeholders, account for product and development requirements, and ensure program scope and execution support successful Entry-Into-Service (EIS). Assess changes against business-case impact and guide team decisions accordingly.

• Lead through collaboration and communication: build relationships with cross-functional leaders and key customers, communicate progress and issues promptly and transparently to internal and external leadership, and influence international or cross-divisional teams without relying on formal authority. Inspire accountability, recognize strengths and development needs, and mentor and coach team members.

• Improve how change is delivered: develop and refine NPD processes and tools, apply organizational change-management principles, and coordinate communication, training, feedback and mitigation. Monitor change effectiveness, navigate cultural diversity and organizational dynamics, and adapt plans and resources to address obstacles.

**What We're Looking For

**

• Master’s degree in Business or a technical field (required).

• At least five years of project management or engineering experience (required); Program Management Professional certification is preferred.

• Strong command of project and program management methods and tools, with consistent follow-up, structured planning, performance monitoring, risk management and timely corrective action.

• Ability to independently lead cross-divisional and international teams in a matrix environment, build strong networks, empower colleagues through delegation and create commitment through open, constructive dialogue.

• Sound judgment in complex situations: anticipate and overcome roadblocks, evaluate alternative solutions, communicate appropriately across stakeholders and adapt effectively to organizational change and cultural differences.

**What You'll Get From Us

**

• We promote from within and support your learning with mentoring, training, and access to global opportunities.

• You’ll have flexibility, autonomy, and support to do your best work while maintaining a healthy work-life balance. Your well-being matters to us.

• We strive to create an inclusive work environment where people of all backgrounds are respected, and valued for who they are.

• You’ll receive benefits like annual bonus, paid vacation, pension plans, personal insurance, and more. These vary by country and contract, but they’re worth asking about—we think they’re pretty great.

**Ready to Make a Difference?

**If this role excites you, we’d love to hear from you! Apply now to start the conversation and learn more about where your career can go with us.

**Our Commitment to Transparency

**All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or other protected category.

As a Specialist, Digital Engagement, you will play a key role in bringing Pandora’s global campaigns to life across digital touchpoints. You will plan, develop, and execute content across web and email, ensuring engaging and high-performing consumer journeys that align with both brand storytelling and commercial priorities.

Working closely with cross-functional stakeholders, you will support campaigns end-to-end - from briefing through to execution - ensuring consistency, quality, and continuous optimisation across channels and markets. You will also contribute to refining customer journeys by leveraging insights, performance data, and user behaviour.

**Key Responsibilities

**

• Execute digital campaigns across web and email in line with global brand and commercial strategies

• Translate campaign concepts into engaging, high-performing digital experiences

Copenhagen, Denmark

_Want to put your financial markets expertise to work across exchanges, market data providers and multiple asset classes? Join Saxo’s Market Data & Exchange Relations team and take ownership in an area connecting markets, technology and commercial relationships.

_**About The Role

**This role offers the opportunity to work at the intersection of financial markets, market data, exchanges and technology in an international environment. You will collaborate with exchanges, market data providers and colleagues across Saxo, helping ensure that the data supporting our trading platforms and internal systems is managed effectively.

The Market Data & Exchange Relations team manages licensing and relationships with the external vendors and exchanges that provide market data to Saxo's trading platforms and internal systems.

Depending on your experience, you may bring established market data expertise to the team or relevant experience from another part of the financial sector and an interest in developing further within market data and exchange relations.

**Your Responsibilities

**Your responsibilities will include a combination of contract management, operational and commercial, including:

• Managing and maintaining relationships with market data vendors and exchanges, including licensing requirements and usage rights

• Negotiating, reviewing and maintaining market data licensing and vendor agreements, including commercial terms, permitted use and redistribution rights

• Acting as a point of contact for exchanges, vendors and other external partners

• Working with internal teams on billing, budgeting and reporting

• Monitoring and analysing market data usage, licensing permissions, entitlements and reporting obligations

• Supporting appropriate and compliant use of licensed market data across the organisation, in line with exchange and vendor licensing terms

• Providing market data licensing expertise and guidance to internal projects, new products and initiatives

• Managing day-to-day enquiries from internal and external stakeholders

• Supporting the ongoing development of processes and controls within the Market Data & Exchange Relations area

**Your profile

**We are interested in candidates with experience from market data, financial markets, exchanges, trading, financial services or a related field.

You may already be an experienced market data professional, or you may have developed relevant knowledge in another area of the financial sector and see market data as your next specialisation.

**

**Click here to create an account and upload your resume and a short motivation. We look forward to getting to know you better!
